assertions.label: create_order
assertions.actual: errors[] has 1 entry: [{"message":"The cart has validation errors","locations":[{"line":1,"column":12}],"path":["createOrderFromCart"],"extensions":{"code":"ValidationError","codes":["ValidationError"]}}]

crossLayerChecks.raw: [EVIDENCE] add_after_convert: cart must NOT grow beyond the pre-conversion state (itemsCount<=1 — the original item remains, no new item is appended). Either errors[] non-empty rejecting the addItem OR itemsCount stays at 1 (silent no-op). NO HTTP 500. Silent acceptance (itemsCount=2) is a P0 bug — duplicate inventory decrement after order.
